project_type: Python quantitative finance library with Baostock API integration
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -e . 2. pytest tests/ -v 3. python examples/quick_start.py
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Python 3.11 default. Can install any PyPI packages.
contribution_requirements: MIT License. Open-source friendly code with docstrings and type hints.
key_patterns: Modular design with separate packages for strategies, algorithms, backtesting, data, and portfolio engine. Each strategy/algorithm is a class implementing a common interface.
directory_structure: src/quant_portfolio/ - main package; strategies/ - 100+ quant strategies; algorithms/ - 100+ advanced algos; backtesting/ - backtest engine; data/ - Baostock data layer; portfolio/ - portfolio construction engine; tests/ - pytest tests; examples/ - usage examples; docs/ - documentation
